thread:
Sam (Product): Quick FYI — ACME tenant asked to accelerate private pilot; they need HSM + burst capacity by end of month. Can we fit this?
Laura (PM): Noted. What are acceptance criteria from ACME?
Ryan (Eng): Need expected qps, sequence length distribution, and whether they require private-only serving.
Mira (Runtime): HSM adds key management constraints. If this is private-only we need a private control plane and no outbound fallbacks. Also prewarm requirements depend on concurrency.
Sam (Product): They want ~200 rps peak, mostly short prompts (avg ~80 tokens); SLA for pilot they asked: 99.9 and p99 < 300ms.
Tony (Infra): 200 rps @80 tokens -> rough estimate: 3-5 A100s with current batching/kv caching. We'll need prewarm and custom autoscale policy. Lead time for GPU allocation is ~48-72h.
Nadia (Security): HSM + private deployment requires compliance sign-off (network isolation + key custody). We'll need the customer's IA questionnaire and a network/dataflow diagram.
Laura (PM): Two things: 1) product needs a canary rollout + rollback plan, 2) document minimum acceptance criteria for go/no-go.
Ryan (Eng): If private-only is hard on timeline, can we propose staged delivery: limited qps pilot first, then full capacity? Any customer constraints on staged approach?
Sam (Product): ACME is flexible on phased pilot but prefers EoM demo. They'd accept limited pilot (50 rps single region) by EoM, full 200 rps in 4-6 weeks.
Mira (Runtime): For a limited pilot we can: enable KV caching, set batch window ~10ms, and precompute cold-start prewarm. Proposed config snippet:
```
model: redwood-llm-v2
batch_window_ms: 10
max_batch_tokens: 4096
kv_cache: enabled
quant_profile: int8_slowwarm
```
Ryan (Eng): I'll run a spike to validate latency+throughput for that config. ETA 48h.
Tony (Infra): Opening infra ticket IR-2345 for GPU + HSM provisioning, owner: @Tony (Infra). ETA: 3 days for hardware, 5 days for full network setup.
Nadia (Security): I'll start compliance checklist and initial threat model. Sam, please DM the IA questionnaire and any contractual constraints re: key custody.
Sam (Product): Sent questionnaire in DM. Canary criteria requested by customer: error rate <1%, p99 <300ms, no PII leakage incidents in eval set.
Laura (PM): OK — decision: scope cut to limited pilot for EoM demo. Action items: (a) Eng — spike prewarm & perf validation (b) Infra — provision GPUs + HSM (c) Security — begin compliance signoff (d) Product — update customer with phased plan and canary criteria.
Ryan (Eng): Spike started. Will post initial perf numbers in #eng-runtime thread.
Mira (Runtime): I'll prepare runtime rollout config and fallback policy. Note: fallback to hosted API requires customer approval for egress; otherwise we need to ensure capacity on private nodes.
Tony (Infra): IR-2345 updated: provisioning started. Will tag infra:oss and runtime teams.
DeployBot: Ticket IR-2345 created by Tony (Infra). Status: provisioning.
Nadia (Security): Preliminary blocker: KMS/HSM vendor needs network ACLs; tagging @Tony to coordinate.
Laura (PM): Let's do a touchdown tomorrow 10am to confirm no blockers. If any blocker >48h appears, we'll escalate to exec sponsorship.
Sam (Product): Thanks all — please @laura for major blockers. :thumbsup:
